about: PPN inside a tax-inclusive shelf price: dpp = round(price / (1 + rate)), then tax = price - dpp (SPEC 2.2). TASKS 5.6.
verification: Arithmetic verified by hand. Still to confirm with the owner and their konsultan pajak: whether this business's shelf prices are quoted inclusive of PPN at all. Indonesian retail usually is; a distributor selling to clinics on an invoice usually is not. The engine does both and the rule row decides, so this is a configuration answer, not a code change.

cases.name: the same money seen from the other side
cases.why: The mirror of the exclusive round-million case. A shelf price of Rp 1.110.000 divides back to exactly Rp 1.000.000 of DPP and Rp 110.000 of PPN, with no remainder. The two directions agreeing on a figure that divides cleanly is the sanity check on the formula itself.

cases.name: a five thousand rupiah item: subtracting and recomputing disagree
cases.why: This is the case SPEC 2.2 was written for, and the cheapest thing on the shelf is where it bites. Rp 5.000 / 1,11 is Rp 4.504,50450..., which rounds to a DPP of Rp 4.505. Subtracting gives PPN of Rp 495 and the parts come to Rp 5.000, the price on the label. Recomputing the tax independently -- Rp 4.505 x 11/100 = Rp 495,55 -- gives Rp 496, and the receipt then adds up to Rp 5.001 for an item marked Rp 5.000. One rupiah, on every such line, in front of the customer. Subtract.

cases.name: a sixty-six thousand rupiah item, where recomputing loses a rupiah the other way
cases.why: Rp 66.000 / 1,11 is Rp 59.459,459..., a DPP of Rp 59.459 and, by subtraction, PPN of Rp 6.541. Recomputing gives Rp 6.540,49 -> Rp 6.540, and the parts come to Rp 65.999. Included alongside the Rp 5.000 case because the independent recomputation errs in both directions, so a system with that bug cannot be spotted by the sign of the discrepancy.

cases.name: a hundred thousand rupiah, repeating decimal
cases.why: Rp 100.000 / 1,11 is Rp 90.090,0900..., a DPP of Rp 90.090 and PPN of Rp 9.910. The DPP nilai lain of 11/12 is why this repeats and why the fraction is carried whole: 0,916666 written out to any number of places is a different number from 11/12, and it is a number no regulation contains (SPEC 2.1).

cases.name: a three line basket at shelf prices
cases.why: The property that matters at the till: the customer pays the sum of the labels, Rp 83.500, and the breakdown printed underneath adds back up to it. Rp 75.225 of DPP and Rp 8.275 of PPN.
